info.name: ShiftManager API
info.description: IA730001 ShiftManager – run folders in order (Collection Runner). Requires the manager account from node scripts/seed.js (ankush12@gmail.com). The collection registers its own temporary employees; afterwards run node scripts/cleanup-smoke.js.

exec: // A random future year keeps the collection repeatable
pm.test("Has count and shifts", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("count"); pm.expect(b.shifts).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Only own shifts", () => { const id = pm.collectionVariables.get("employeeId"); pm.response.json().shifts.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.employeeId._id).to.eql(id)); });
pm.test("Only public key exposed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.publicKey).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.property("privateKey"); });

item.name: Manager test push (200 if subscribed in browser, else 404)

exec: pm.test("Status is 200 (subscribed) or 404 (no subscription yet)", () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
